title: Use Container Selection blue indicator and tote lookup to identify tote presence and tote number
summary: On the live Container Selection screen, dark blue indicates tote presence and light blue indicates an empty rack. Selecting a location shows a box icon and the tote number. You can also find a tote by typing a location number and selecting the rack/AGV where it is located (if it is in the system).
when_to_use: Use when you need to confirm whether a station/rack location currently has a tote present and, if present, identify the tote number and its location using the Container Selection screen.
roles_and_responsibilities: Operator: Perform the Container Selection screen checks (indicator color, select location tile, and use the location lookup field when needed).
access_or_tools_needed: Tipper HMI / WebVisu / VISU (Container Selection screen) or AVEVA HMI tote/container views (depending on site configuration)

system_preconditions: Container Selection screen is available and accessible on the live HMI.

visual_references.description: Container Selection screen example showing: dark blue = tote presence, light blue = empty rack; selecting shows a box icon and tote number; includes location-number lookup guidance.

steps.title: Open the live Container Selection screen used for totes/containers
steps.purpose: Access the UI that displays tote presence/absence via blue indicators and supports selecting a location to reveal tote details.
steps.instruction: Open the live Container Selection screen used for totes/containers.
steps.expected_result: The Container Selection screen is displayed with station/rack tiles and the blue indicator(s) on top of some stations.
steps.healthy_condition: You can see the station/rack tiles and the small blue indicator(s) on top of stations.
steps.failure_condition: The Container Selection screen does not load, or the station/rack tiles/blue indicators are not visible.

actions.label: Open Container Selection
actions.exact_action: Open the live Container Selection screen used for totes/containers.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: OCR/transcript describes the Container Selection screen and the blue indicator meaning and selection behavior.

steps.title: Scan station/rack tiles for the small blue indicator on top of stations
steps.purpose: Identify which locations currently show a tote-related status indicator.
steps.instruction: Scan the station/rack tiles for the small blue indicator on top of stations.
steps.expected_result: You locate one or more tiles with a small blue indicator on top of the station/rack.
steps.healthy_condition: Blue indicator(s) are visible on the station/rack tiles.
steps.failure_condition: No blue indicators are visible on the tiles when you expect tote presence/absence indicators to be shown.

actions.label: Scan tiles for blue indicator
actions.exact_action: Scan the station/rack tiles for the small blue indicator on top of stations.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: Transcript: 'there's a small blue thing on top of some of these stations.'

steps.title: Classify the indicator color (dark blue vs light blue)
steps.purpose: Determine whether the selected location has a tote present or is empty based on the indicator color.
steps.instruction: Classify the indicator color: confirm dark blue = tote presence and light blue = empty rack.
steps.expected_result: You can correctly distinguish dark blue (tote present) from light blue (empty rack) for the location(s) you plan to check.
steps.healthy_condition: Dark blue locations correspond to tote presence; light blue locations correspond to empty racks.
steps.failure_condition: Indicator colors do not match the expected meaning (e.g., a location appears dark blue but behaves like an empty rack after selection).

actions.label: Confirm indicator color meaning
actions.exact_action: Classify the indicator color: confirm dark blue = tote presence and light blue = empty rack.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: OCR: 'Dark blue indicates the presence of a tote. While light blue represents empty rack.'

steps.title: Select the station/rack tile with the blue indicator you want to check
steps.purpose: Trigger the UI response that reveals tote details for the chosen location.
steps.instruction: Click/select the station/rack tile with the blue indicator you want to check.
steps.expected_result: The selected location responds in the UI (selection state changes) and reveals tote details.
steps.healthy_condition: The tile selection is recognized by the UI and you can proceed to verify the tote details response.
steps.failure_condition: Selecting the tile does not change the UI state or does not reveal tote details.

actions.label: Select tile
actions.exact_action: Click/select the station/rack tile with the blue indicator you want to check.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: OCR: 'If you select it, a box icon will show as well as the tote number.'

steps.title: Verify box icon and tote number after selecting the location
steps.purpose: Confirm tote presence/absence and identify the tote number for the selected location.
steps.instruction: Verify the expected UI response: confirm a box icon appears and the tote number is displayed for the selected location.
steps.expected_result: For a dark blue (tote present) location, a box icon appears and the tote number is displayed. For a light blue (empty rack) location, the location represents an empty rack (no tote presence indicated).
steps.healthy_condition: Dark blue locations show tote presence with a box icon and tote number after selection; light blue locations represent empty racks.
steps.failure_condition: If the selected location does not show the box icon and tote number when the indicator is dark blue, or if the UI does not reflect the expected tote presence/absence behavior.

actions.label: Check box icon + tote number
actions.exact_action: Verify the expected UI response: confirm a box icon appears and the tote number is displayed for the selected location.

stop_or_escalate_if: If the selected location does not show the box icon and tote number when the indicator is dark blue, stop and escalate to support for system-state verification.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: OCR: 'If you select it, a box icon will show as well as the tote number.' plus dark blue vs light blue meaning.

steps.title: Find a tote by location number using the Container Selection lookup
steps.purpose: Look up tote presence and tote number by entering a location number and selecting the rack/AGV where it is located (when present in the system).
steps.instruction: If you need to find a tote by location, type the location number into the Container Selection lookup field and select the rack or AGV where it is located (only if it is in the system).
steps.expected_result: Entering a location number and selecting the corresponding rack/AGV returns the tote’s presence and tote number when the tote is in the system.
steps.healthy_condition: Lookup returns the expected tote presence and tote number for the selected rack/AGV associated with that location number.
steps.failure_condition: Lookup does not return the expected rack/AGV location when the tote is believed to be in the system.

actions.label: Enter location number and select rack/AGV
actions.exact_action: You can also find a tote by typing the location number in and selecting the rack or AGV it's located on if its in the system.

stop_or_escalate_if: If entering a location number does not return the expected rack/AGV location (when the tote is believed to be in the system), stop and escalate.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: OCR: 'You can also find a tote by typing the location number in and selecting the rack or AGV it's located on if its in the system.'

success_criteria: Dark blue locations are confirmed as tote present (box icon + tote number after selection).
Light blue locations are confirmed as empty racks.
Location-number lookup returns tote presence and tote number for the correct rack/AGV when the tote is in the system.
healthy_conditions: Container Selection screen shows blue indicators on station/rack tiles.
Selecting a dark blue location displays a box icon and tote number.
Selecting a light blue location corresponds to an empty rack state.
failure_conditions: Dark blue location does not display a box icon and tote number after selection.
Location-number lookup does not return the expected rack/AGV location when the tote is believed to be in the system.
escalation_guidance: Stop and escalate to support for system-state verification when the UI behavior does not match the indicator meaning (dark blue without box icon/tote number) or when location-number lookup does not return the expected rack/AGV.
